notes.title: A MAZE - Live Stream with Developer
notes.notes: Hey, to celebrate the latest A MAZE event I'll be streaming some live gameplay of Tux and Fanny. It's been a little while since I played so it should be fun remembering everything we packed into this game. Come drop in and ask any questions about the game and I'll be happy to answer!
